title: Academic Affiliation and Departments Overview
content: DAVIET is affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKG PTU), Jalandhar, and approved by AICTE. Academic departments listed on the official website include Computer Science and Engineering & AIML, Civil Engineering, Computer Applications, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Management, Applied Sciences, and Hospitality & Tourism Management. Academic calendars and AICTE Extension of Approval (EOA) documents are published under Academics on davietjal.org. For the latest calendar, refer to the Academic Calendar links on the official site.

title: IKG-PTU Official Academic Calendar (Odd & Even Semesters)
content:
Official IKG-PTU (I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University) Academic Calendar for DAVIET and affiliated institutions:

• ODD SEMESTER (Autumn Session — Semesters 1, 3, 5, 7):
  - Commencement of Session / Classes: Mid-July to early August (1st year batches commence early August after centralized counselling & induction).
  - Mid-Semester Tests (MST-1 & MST-2): MST-1 is conducted in September; MST-2 is conducted in late October / early November.
  - End Semester Theory Examinations: Mid-November to December.
  - Practical Examinations: Conducted following theory exams in December.
  - Winter Vacation: Late December through the first week of January.

• EVEN SEMESTER (Spring Session — Semesters 2, 4, 6, 8):
  - Commencement of Session / Classes: First to second week of January.
  - Mid-Semester Tests (MST-1 & MST-2): MST-1 is held in late February; MST-2 in April.
  - End Semester Theory Examinations: May to June.
  - Practical Examinations: Conducted by respective departments in June.
  - Summer Vacation / Mandatory Industrial Training: June to mid-July.

• Official Calendar Notifications:
  - Download official IKG-PTU regular academic calendars and circulars directly from the university portal: https://ptu.ac.in/academic-calendar/
  - DAVIET departmental schedules: https://davietjal.org/academic-calendar/
